answer: Make attestation pay only through honest grading. Each epoch an agent must judge peers' work, but salted into its queue are hidden gold-set items with known answers, a few sweet drops of nectar among real tasks. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own clones to farm rewards flunks these spot-checks and gets slashed. To fool the audit they would have to actually solve every gold item, as exacting as scoring a sonnet's meter, making fakery cost as much as honest work, and the trail turns any we-all-vouch-for-each-other fable into provable collusion.
